correctness.rationale: For r induced flags, every selected point touches two of the 9-r unselected lines, so 2r<=3(9-r), forcing r<=5. Occupancy profiles of 5 points across vertical affine columns show that tangents exist exactly for unions of two nonparallel allowed affine lines; 3 slope pairs times 3² choices yield 27 configurations. Flag transitivity and exact five-flag construction show four two-exchange neighbors each, yielding 18 unique edge-disjoint triangles. Recovering the 18-vertex triangle-intersection graph yields the 3-net of order 3, hence Pappus; exchange graph is its line graph. Independent direct incidence enumeration and shortest-path calculation verified the complete 27-vertex exchange graph, 54 edges, 18 triangles, pair distances 54,108,162,27. The claim is finite and the exhaustive proof bounds all candidates.
